newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks soar in early trade, index hits record.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks soar in early trade, index hits record.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks soared in early Monday morning trade following Wall Street's record close on Friday and continued buying in red chips, brokers said.
The Hang Seng Index surged to a record high of 14,481.64 before steadying at 14,449, up 117 points or 0.82 percent.

"The rise in blue chips is seen slowing but buying in red chips is going crazy," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities. Players were ignoring fundamentals and buying on hopes of future asset injections, he said.
Blue chips were generally higher with Hang Seng Bank leading the rise, up HK$1.50 to HK$91.75.
